messages:
ana: Heads-up: noticed invoice delta ~3% for several customers in EU last week. console shows tokens = 1,248,980 but billing invoice lines sum to 1,212,400. Suspect client-side sampling for some SDK versions.

mike: any pattern? sdk version, route, or customer tier?

ana: all on gateway-proxy v2.3.x, customers with sampling opt-in (old AB test). sampling param is 'client_sample_rate' in SDK header. I can dump a sample of events.

sophie: if events are sampled client-side but we don't persist sample_rate into metering events, invoice will be raw counts not extrapolated -> underspend on invoice

james: can you paste the header payload we see in the ingest?

ana:
```
{"x-client-sample-rate": "0.02", "client-sdk": "js-1.4.3", "route": "/v1/generate"}
```

mike: ok. current metering-ingest strips unknown headers for safety. we should either preserve x-client-sample-rate or convert upstream to event.token_count * (1/sample_rate)

kevin: leaning toward preserving provenance and doing extrapolation at billing stage. easier to audit (we'll show both raw_count and extrapolated_count)

sophie: +1. then we can show 'billing_extrapolated = true' in console and flag customers on rollouts UX if using client sampling

james: runtime impact? we'd need to change event schema and update event-store backfills. cost estimate?

mike: small schema bump: add string 'sample_provenance' and number 'sample_rate'. Ingest adds them if header present. Billing job multiplies tokens by 1/sample_rate. Backfill only for events after 2025-10-01 (when SDK rollout started)

ana: urgent ask: some customers are getting invoices lower than console usage and support tickets are incoming. We should hotfix: temporarily enable a small extrapolation heuristic on the billing worker when sample_rate missing but SDK detected. heuristic: if sdk=js-1.4.x and proxy header missing -> extrapolate by 1.02

kevin: meh, heuristics smell bad. prefer opt-in quick patch: generate a 'suspect_sampling' alert to billing-sre + support, and apply manual credits while we fix schema

mike: fine. I'll push a patch to ingest to persist x-client-sample-rate and add a console flag to show 'sampled events present' per-customer. Prepare a follow-up for rollout UX to surface this in the billing tab.

deploy-bot: deploy started: metering-ingest v1.12.3 -> v1.12.4 (preserve x-client-sample-rate)

billing-bot: ticket created: #BILL-4823 "Potential underbilling due to client sampling" assigned to @mike @sophie

sophie: docs: we'll add note to 'metering caveats' page + recommend server-side sampling or explicit server header in SDKs. Also add a console warning when sampled events > 1% of total

ana: thanks. next actions: mike to PR ingest, kevin to coordinate credits SOP, sophie to update docs + console flag, james to scope backfill. I'll compile a support playbook.

mike: PR open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/metering/pull/421

ana: will post customer-facing note after we confirm deploy + quick audit of invoices.

kevin: ping me if a customer escalates; I'll hold a rolling credit window.

sophie: :thumbsup:
